proxy_name.description: The name of this proxy instance (used in headers and logs).

server_ports.description: List of ports to listen on for HTTP traffic. Each entry must be an integer or port:interface specification (e.g., '8080' or '8080::').

server_ssl_port.description: Port to use for HTTPS traffic when ssl_enabled is true.

http_accept_enabled.description: Enable accepting new HTTP connections (must be 1 for normal operation).

http_accept_threads.description: Number of threads dedicated to accepting HTTP connections.

connect_attempts_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for a connection to the origin before timing out.

connect_attempts_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries to connect to the origin before failing.

post_connect_attempts_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for data after establishing a connection to the origin.

transaction_no_activity_timeout_in.description: Idle timeout (seconds) for client requests with no activity.

transaction_active_timeout_in.description: Maximum total time (seconds) a client transaction can take.

response_active_timeout_in.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response from the origin.

cache_enable_checksum.description: Enable checksumming of cached objects to detect corruption.

cache_enable_read_while_writer.description: Allow cache reads while a write is in progress (improves concurrency).

cache_min_average_object_size.description: Estimated average size (in bytes) of cached objects (affects internal tuning).

cache_threads_per_disk.description: Number of threads used for I/O per disk or volume.

cache_volumes.description: List of cache volumes. Each volume has a size (in bytes) and remap flag (true = this volume is used for remapping).

log_perm.description: File permissions for log files (octal string).

log_rolling_size_mb.description: Log file size (in MB) that triggers rotation.

enable_remap.description: Enable URL remapping (required for reverse proxy mode).

remap_required.description: Require remap rules for every request (disables direct origin access).

pristine_host_hdr.description: Preserve the original Host header (1) or replace with origin (0).

http2_enabled.description: HTTP/2 protocol support enabled (must match enable_http2).

http2_max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum concurrent HTTP/2 streams per connection.

ssl_cert_path.description: Directory containing TLS server certificates (PEM files).

ssl_key_path.description: Directory containing TLS private keys (PEM files).

ssl_client_verify_server.description: Verify server certificate when acting as client to origin (0=off,1=optional,2=required).

exec_thread_autoconfig.description: Automatically configure number of executor threads.

exec_thread_limit.description: Maximum number of executor threads (if autoconfig=false).

exec_thread_affinity.description: Enable thread affinity to CPU cores (1=on,0=off).

ram_cache_size_mb.description: RAM cache size (in MB) for frequently accessed objects.

max_redirections.description: Maximum HTTP redirect hops to follow.
